cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: The code constructs a shell command using /bin/sh -c with user-controlled input (path containing %u substitution of href), which is the exact mechanism of CWE-77

connection.evidence: path parameter flows from browser configuration or editor input, href parameter contains user-controlled URLs, and both are concatenated into shell command via %u substitution at line 142

diff_causality.evidence: This line is newly added (change_type: A) and directly introduces the vulnerable shell execution mechanism that did not exist before

security_control.evidence: No validation or sanitization of path before shell execution. %u substitution occurs without escaping, allowing arbitrary command injection
security_control.required_control: Input validation and proper shell argument escaping
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-77 requires neutralization of shell metacharacters when constructing shell commands from user input
existing_controls_checked: No input validation observed before substitution
No shell escaping of href parameter
security_control.deficiency_evidence: User-controlled href is directly substituted into shell command template without validation or escaping

concrete_impact.evidence: Arbitrary command execution is demonstrated through the shell -c mechanism with user-controlled input

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, the shell command execution vulnerability would not exist as the code would lack the mechanism to execute arbitrary shell commands with user input.
supporting_evidence: Line 142: path.replace("%u", href) directly substitutes user-controlled href into command template
Line 145: os.execv("/bin/sh", ["/bin/sh", "-c", path]) executes the constructed command via shell
path parameter sources include browser configuration and editor input from environment/user
unresolved_facts: Specific validation mechanisms for browser configuration input
Exact user control boundaries for href parameter
review_comment: The added code constructs shell commands using user-controlled input via %u substitution without validation or escaping. User-provided URLs and configuration values are directly incorporated into shell commands executed via /bin/sh -c, enabling command injection. Replace the shell execution with parameterized subprocess calls that properly escape arguments and avoid shell interpretation.
